implementation.paid_probe: POST /api/config/probe?target=llm|embedding|milvus requires PLATFORM_OPERATOR_SUBJECTS membership in both Java and Python; workspace admin alone is insufficient
implementation.probe_controls: durable provider/account/model cooldown, shared cached safe result, audit before transport and after completion, separate probe period quota
implementation.reservation: single database transaction conditionally reserves every dimension before each HTTP attempt; failure rolls back all counters and sends no request
implementation.retries: every transport retry and structured-format retry reserves another HTTP attempt; new provider instances reuse the durable counters
implementation.settlement: cumulative reservations, actual input/output, pending exposure and unknown exposure remain separate; missing usage never refunds tokens; settlement is idempotent
implementation.identity: paid_scope(workspace_id, subject, purpose); research Execution resolves its persisted run ownership; missing scope or unavailable ledger fails closed
implementation.demo: local demo generation/embedding needs no real identity; any actual HTTP POST still needs an explicit accounting scope and ledger
